mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced industrial output weighs on the economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, signaling persistent inflationary pressures, the combination predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed's tightening weighs on growth.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with persistent inflation
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE), declining by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months, signals an improving labor market and strengthening consumer sector that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.3pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55, indicating strong manufacturing activity, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, signaling accommodative monetary policy, the combination predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as easy financial conditions support industrial growth.
regime_hint: early-cycle industrial boom with easy monetary policy
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as an increase of more than 1 percentage point over 3 months, signals a sharp tightening of monetary policy that will weigh on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
